source.description: Container-for-content entities anchored to real, corpus-attested sentences (ConMeC CONTAINER category, METONYMIC label -- see engine/src/Metonymy/ContainerContent.hs). The containers and contents themselves are not independently Wikidata-linkable real-world entities (a specific glass/carton/six-pack in one narrative has no QID), so this graph is hand-built like data/synthetic-towers-snapshot, just grounded in real sentences rather than invented ones.
